note: R7-U: the root's itemStyle / lineStyle / areaStyle under the series and the markers. Each case settled; `pens` the sorted set of stroke|width|dash|offset|cap/join/miter of every stroked path under the series' views (part '') or the marker components' views (part marker), as series-borders.js; `seen` the paths, `n` the stroked ones; `looks` opacity|shadowBlur|shadowOffsetX|shadowOffsetY|shadowColor; `fills` the fills; `shapes` each rect and sector (canvas frame), its corners appended as |r:a,b,c,d where one is above nought (a rect's RectShape.r expanded as roundRect does, a sector's normalizeCornerRadius); `curves` each Line / BezierCurve as x1|y1|x2|y2|cpx1|cpy1. `defaults` the leaves each type's defaultOption holds under the three blocks.
